notes:
CRM notes: 
- Enterprise procurement for mission-critical conversational & reranking flows. Primary ask: deterministic throughput guarantees and clear burst behavior.
- Quote from CTO: "We cannot accept unpredictable throughput during peak settlement windows — we need a guaranteed min tokens/sec per customer pool."
- SE POC (Priya) ran synthetic tails: baseline sustained ~12k tokens/sec across 6 GPU pool (mixed A100+H100), 95p latency ~110ms for 64-token prompts, 99p ~360ms on long sequences. Customer wants 95p <150ms, 99p <400ms as SLA targets.
- Throughput ask: min 10k tokens/sec sustained per dedicated pool, concurrency cap 120 sessions (session = conversational channel), peak burst allowance 2x sustained for 30s before queue/backpressure; auto-burst billing to be capped or billed as overage depending on contract.
- Reserved GPU planning: customer expects 8x A100-equivalent reserved hardware initially, with option to scale to 12 GPUs in Q3. Wants capacity planning math in SOW (tokens/sec per GPU by model/quantization).
- Measurement and credits: customer requests token/sec measured at the edge egress aggregated over 1min sliding window; credits formula proposed: 5% service credit for failure to meet min tokens/sec for >10 minutes in a day. Legal pushing for stronger remedy.
- Security/residency: VPC private control plane, customer-managed KMS, audit log retention 7 years for compliance team.
- POC next: run customer production traffic replay (anonymized) against dedicated pool next week; need drive link for trace sample.
- Quick items: attach perf matrix, include explicit concurrency behavior for prioritized vs background queues.
- Notes style: shorthand, stakeholders: CTO (Asha Rao), Head of Platform (Marcus Li), procurement lead (Elena Soto).
